newsitem.title: UK: US May oil refinery runs highest since 1979 - IEA.
newsitem.headline: US May oil refinery runs highest since 1979 - IEA.

text.p: US oil refinery throughputs soared 800,000 barrels per day (bpd) in May to 15.04 million bpd but declines in Japan and Europe more than offset this and the total for OECD countries fell by 140,000 bpd to 33.26 million, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said on Tuesday.
The U.S. total was the highest level since 1979 and took refinery utilisation rates to 97.2 percent, the highest level in 25 years, the IEA said, adding that the June figure was likely to be higher.
"Weekly U.S. statistics to June 27 suggest throughput levels increased further to new record highs of more than 15.2 mbpd, reflecting robust product demand and relatively high refining margins.
The OECD (Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development) groups together the world's leading industrialised nations.
Japanese throughputs in May fell on a monthly basis by 700,000 bpd to 3.72 million bpd, amid a heavy spring maintenance programme, while OECD Europe's runs fell by 230,000 bpd to 12.37 million.
